contexts.text: In this muddy lake are malignant women from the province of the bladder.
Under Kidney, see this reference, and at AC 5380. AC 5381.
They who are in the Hells correspond to such things as are voided through the intestines and the bladder...
(Spirits of the neck of the bladder, Described.)
The ureters and bladder, which go forth from the kidneys = exterior truth and its investigation, and also castigation.
Like a bladder full of stinking gall...
On the Spirits who represent the kidneys and the bladder in man. SE 867. SE 938. SE 959.
They who constitute the bladder are the worst, for they search out filthy things of nature, and desire to punish severely, or insanely, by means of tepid or warm waters...
His urinary bladder appeared so dilated as to fill the whole man...
